item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["c232fb4658cbc84c69ff"],"operation":"Compile test/ares-test-fuzz.c from build.sh.","condition":"The entry includes \"ares.h\" after the public header moves under include, while the compile command supplies only -I.","capability":"Resolve \"ares.h\" through the required include directory, such as -Iinclude.","consequence":"Compilation cannot find the public header.","equivalence_reason":"Singleton: this concerns header lookup during compilation."},{"member_ids":["f48aca0cce01a3fcd76b"],"operation":"Link the fuzz binary after make all.","condition":"The library target moves to src/lib, while the link command names $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a.","capability":"Link the archive produced by the src/lib library target.","consequence":"The link command cannot find the archive at its hard-coded path.","equivalence_reason":"Singleton: this concerns archive location during linking, a different operation and capability from header lookup."}]}
